name: Soccer Mommy
description:
'''Sophia Regina Allison''' (born May 27, 1997), better known by her stage name '''Soccer Mommy''', is an American [[indie rock]] singer-songwriter from [[Nashville, Tennessee]]. Her music combines elements of 1990s [[alternative rock]] with the mainstream [[pop music]] of the 2000s, which is referred to by some journalists as "[[bubblegrunge]]". Additionally, she is known for her confessional lyrical style and personal subject matter.

Allison started her career by self-releasing music on [[Bandcamp]] in her late teenage years. Her debut studio album, ''[[Clean (Soccer Mommy album)|Clean]]'', was released in 2018. She has followed up by releasing another three albums: ''[[Color Theory (album)|Color Theory]]'' (2020), ''[[Sometimes, Forever]]'' (2022), and ''[[Evergreen (Soccer Mommy album)|Evergreen]]'' (2024), all of which have received positive reviews from critics. Throughout her career, she has toured with bands and artists including [[Stephen Malkmus and the Jicks|Stephen Malkmus]], [[Mitski]], [[Kacey Musgraves]], [[Slowdive]], [[Jay Som]], [[Frankie Cosmos]], [[Phoebe Bridgers]], [[Snail Mail (musician)|Snail Mail]], [[Paramore]], [[Liz Phair]], and [[Vampire Weekend]].
